en: A black‑and‑white/sepia panoramic view over a valley town surrounded by rolling hills. In the foreground are trees framing the scene; below runs a river and a railway line with tracks curving along the valley. Industrial chimneys and factory buildings occupy the lower right, while the middle distance shows a dense cluster of houses and several taller towers or church steeples. The town extends up the hillside. At the top right in red Gothic-style script is the caption identifying the location and viewpoint.
